applies_to: AGC 150 Marine software 1.39.0 (marine Modbus server tables revision E), GEN-M (marine genset) controller type. The iE 150 Marine tables 4189341431 rev. H match these tables.
summary: The AGC 150 Marine is DEIF's marine genset controller for single or paralleled ship generators. It is a Modbus server on Ethernet (Modbus TCP) and on its RS-485 ports (Modbus RTU). This map lists the GEN-M-type AC measurements, energy and hour counters, DC supply, mode and status flags, and the control command words used for remote start, stop, breaker and mode commands.

addressing.note: The 'Modbus address' column is the address in the request. The tables also print a 6-digit PLC address one higher (input 501 = PLC 300502).

source.title: AGC 150 Marine Modbus server tables
source.pages: Spreadsheet sheets 'Holding register (03;06;16)', 'Input register (04)', 'Discrete input contact (02)', GEN-M column; data formats and comm settings from AGC 150 Modbus server user manual 4189341435-B

notes: The source is an Excel workbook. Each row has a scaling exponent x; the value is raw x 10^-x, so x=2 means scale 0.01. Units are as printed.
32-bit values are ABCD: the manual (section 3.4) puts the high 16 bits at the lower address.

Data formats, RS-485 settings and the communication-error timer come from the AGC 150 Modbus server user manual 4189341435-B (https://deif-cdn-umbraco.azureedge.net/media/w25puznj/agc-150-modbus-server-user-manual-4189341435-uk.pdf).
Only rows marked for the GEN-M controller type are listed; the ENG-M (engine drive) type reuses addresses.

Left out: configurable area 0-499, analogue/multi-inputs and CIO values, alarm bits, EIC engine data (including 26000 upward), DAVR, power-management, the ASCII controller-name words 770-775, the command-flag coils, and input 767 (reactive power load printed with unit kW).
Parameters are read and written at an address-area start plus the parameter's USW address (for example 12 + 6000 = 6012 for alarm acknowledge of over-voltage 1).
The active-alarm list is at input registers 28000-28099 (each holds the USW address of an active alarm); not listed.

integration.summary: Read input registers 501-538 with function 04 for generator values and 1019 for the active mode. Write holding register 5 or 6 with bit 0 set plus the command bit to start, stop, open/close breakers or change mode.
integration.enable: RS-485: set ID (7511/7521) and speed (7512/7522) under Communication > RS485. Ethernet: set the IP under Settings > Communication > Ethernet setup or in the utility software.
integration.watchdog: RS-485 communication error: enable with 7516/7526, timer 7513/7523 (1-100 s, default 10 s), fail class 7517/7527 (default Warning).
quirks: A command word is ignored unless bit 0 is 1 in the same write.
Function 04 addresses 0-499 are a user-configurable copy area.
setup: RS-485 default ID 3 and 9600 baud; 9600, 19200, 38400 or 115200 baud selectable.
gotchas: AC voltages, currents and powers are whole units (scale 1); frequency and power factor use 0.01, and DC supply voltage uses 0.1.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
